headlines.text: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4.00% in a 10-2 vote with Cook and Hammack dissenting for a hike; traders still lean toward a December hike after hot inflation data
Nasdaq closes down nearly 3% in its worst session since June, capping its worst month since March 2025, as AI-spending jitters erase hundreds of billions in tech market value
Intel shares close down nearly 29% at $65.76, the stock's worst day in decades, as a weak Q4 revenue outlook overshadowed a Q3 earnings beat and dragged Dell, AMD and Nvidia lower too
Amazon claws back from a 7% opening plunge to close down just 1.4%, as AWS's 39% revenue surge to a record $46B offset worries over $220B of 2026 capex guidance
Reddit shares plunge over 12% despite a Q3 beat, as weak Q4 revenue guidance and warnings of falling Google search referrals trigger a wave of analyst downgrades
Chevron tops Q3 earnings estimates with $9.9B profit as record U.S. production from the Hess acquisition offsets softer crude prices
